turns.reply:
It changes both! Your training will shift to focus on building strength and muscle, while your food changes to support that growth.

Moving from a cut to building muscle means your daily calorie target will go up to fuel your workouts and help build new tissue, along with an updated protein target. 

Once you tap Confirm on the card above, your new calorie and macro targets will update straight away, and your training plan will rebuild to match. 💪
